inputs.question: Where is the overhead electric line (OHE) located on this landscape plan? Show me the path of the overhead electric line and identify any trees or planting areas within 15 feet lateral distance from it. What are the distances from specific trees to the overhead electric line?
inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.regionHint: Look at the entire landscape plan for any overhead electric line markings labeled as OHE or shown as overhead utility lines crossing the property
inputs.classifierReasoning: Although the agent question begins with sheet discovery and feature identification (locating OHE and trees), it explicitly culminates in a measurement request: 'What are the distances from specific trees to the overhead electric line?' The checklist requirement is a distance-based compliance check (15 lateral feet), and the agent is asking for the actual clearance distances needed to verify compliance.
